title: HUEO | Log video restoration and color grading on iPhone, iPad and Mac
description: Restore a batch of camera Log clips on iPhone, grade them locally and send them back to Photos with their original capture dates. Try 30 successful file exports.
heroText: Bring natural color back to a batch of camera clips. Export to Photos with the original capture date when your footage includes it.

steps: Select clips from Photos or Files. Check the camera and Log profile, then preview the technical restoration.
Adjust exposure, white balance or curves on one clip. Apply the shared adjustments to the rest of the shoot.
Find it under the shoot date
Export your chosen clips to Photos. When the source contains a capture date and your export settings preserve it, the finished video keeps that date.

guideTitle: Restore Insta360 Luna Ultra I-Log video on iPhone | HUEO guide
guideDescription: Import original Luna Ultra I-Log footage, check the input profile and restore a batch on your iPhone. Export to Photos with the available original capture date.
guideHeading: Restore Luna Ultra I-Log footage on iPhone
guideIntro: Start with an original clip recorded in I-Log on your camera. This walkthrough covers non-RAW, 10-bit HEVC footage from an Insta360 Luna Ultra.
comparisonTitle: Compare Luna Ultra I-Log with HUEO’s Rec.709 export
comparisonCaption: The left half shows the original 10-bit I-Log. The right half shows the same frame exported from HUEO in Rec.709 SDR. Watch the blue beside the sunlit stone, then the yellow ferry against the water.
comparisonDiscussion: Watch the vertical version and join the discussion on YouTube
guideSteps: Connect your memory card to the iPhone, or save your clips to Photos first. In HUEO, choose From Files or From Photos and select the clips you want to restore.
To copy photos and videos from an external device into your library first, use the separate Import to Photos tool on the home screen.
Open Restore and check the input profile. If you recorded in I-Log and need to choose a profile, select I-Log / Rec.2020. In HUEO 1.1.8 and later, search for Luna Ultra or I-Log to find it.
Clips shot in a standard color mode already have contrast. Keep the correct input interpretation for those clips to avoid applying a second conversion.
Compare a frame, then grade the batch
Pause on a frame and compare with the original. Inspect skies, skin tones or deep shadows. Adjust exposure or white balance, then apply the shared adjustments to other clips.
Each clip keeps its own technical input transform. Preview clips from different lighting conditions before exporting the batch.
In Export, choose your output settings and Photos as the destination. After saving, inspect the capture date on the finished video in Photos.
Keeping the date requires a usable timestamp in the source. Sort your library by capture date to find the result under the original shoot day.
